purpose: Document first-party discovery, current viewer configuration, and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: The official Ministry of Land map.land.gov.bd viewer and DLRS settlement map-search service are real first-party public services relevant to Habiganj. The current viewer JavaScript was inspected and the anonymous administrative cascade returned Sylhet division and Habiganj district. The bounded next-level response returned Bahubal only, so exact Habiganj city/Sadar coverage was not established. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account or personal fields were requested.
registryAssessment: Local/public map and procedure evidence is present through the official Ministry of Land/DLRS viewer and Habiganj district administration procedure material. This does not establish a city-maintained parcel-vector registry, complete city coverage, or legal-title access.

queries.query: Habiganj Bangladesh official cadastral map parcel land records map API site:gov.bd
queries.outcome: Official Ministry of Land viewer, DLRS map-search portal, Habiganj district pages, and Survey of Bangladesh map material found.

queries.query: হবিগঞ্জ সরকারি ভূমি নকশা মৌজা মানচিত্র খতিয়ান অনলাইন
queries.outcome: Official Bengali Ministry of Land viewer, DLRS sources, Habiganj district procedure material and an official land-office service page found; no safe parcel geometry obtained.

attempts.result: Official viewer loaded over TLS; current HTML and JavaScript/configuration inspected.
Current configuration exposed /getAdminByCode, /getGeomByCode, WKT geometry handling, EPSG:4326 input and EPSG:3857 rendering, plus the configured GIS host.
Initial request without the viewer session was rejected as expired/page-token mismatch; no credentials or private token used.
Fresh anonymous session returned Sylhet division code 60 and Habiganj district code 6036.
Bounded Habiganj district next-level request returned only Bahubal code 603605; this was not treated as evidence that Habiganj citywide parcels are absent.
Official GIS host returned Service Unavailable; no parcel layer capabilities, schema, CRS response or geometry was retained.
Official DLRS map-search page reviewed; it exposes administrative, mouza, sheet and dag selectors, but no anonymous exact-point parcel geometry was obtained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not performed against a parcel polygon. Administrative hierarchy and service reachability only; exact-point miss/extent miss is not inferred as citywide absence.

remainingUncertainty: Habiganj Sadar/city exact parcel inclusion, stable native parcel identity, parcel CRS/schema, and citywide coverage remain unverified. The official GIS service may be temporarily unavailable or require a selected mouza/table/plot context.
runtimeAssessment: held; serial reviewer must independently qualify any adapter
